app.name: Fretboard Freedom
app.tagline: Know the neck. Hear the music. Play freely.

home.exploreHint: See any scale anywhere on the fretboard, tap to hear it
home.freePlayHint: A random groove starts with one more tap. Just play.
home.notesHint: Find any note on the neck, fast
home.improvHint: Play over the band and see the chord on the neck
home.chordsHint: Every chord, everywhere on the neck

explorer.tapHint: Tap any spot on the neck to hear it.
explorer.legendRoot: {{note}} = home. Phrases sound finished when they land here.
explorer.legendScale: Other notes in the scale. Safe to play, they lead back home.
explorer.whatIsRoot: Try it: play a few notes, then end on a red dot. Hear how it sounds "done"?
explorer.legendBlue: The blue note: gritty and bluesy. Bend into it or slide past it.

settings.title: Settings
settings.customTuningHint: Low to high, with octaves, e.g. D2 A2 D3 G3 B3 E4
settings.invalidTuning: That tuning doesn't look right. Use notes with octaves, low string first.
settings.backupHint: Save all your data to a file, or load it on another device.

onboarding.welcome: Welcome! Let's set things up in under a minute.
onboarding.handQuestion: Which hand do you strum with?
onboarding.stylesQuestion: What music do you love to play?

scaleHints.blues: Pentatonic plus the gritty blue note

notes.title: Know every note
notes.intro: Short 60-second rounds. The app keeps asking about the spots you miss most.
notes.mode: How do you want to practise?

name.label: Name it
name.hint: A spot lights up, you say which note it is

find.label: Find it
find.hint: Find a note on one string

findAll.label: Find them all
findAll.hint: Find every place a note lives

play.label: Play it
play.hint: Play the note on your guitar, the mic checks you

levels.lowTwo: Low E + A strings, all notes
levels.highE: High E string (same as low E!)

notes.heatmapHint: Green = solid, yellow = getting there, red = needs love. Grey spots haven't come up yet.
notes.heatmapEmpty: Play a few rounds and your weak spots will show up here.
notes.micDenied: The app can't hear you: microphone access is blocked. On iPhone: Settings, Safari, Microphone, then allow.
notes.micTip: Tip: play one clean note and let it ring.
notes.octavesHint: Lines connect the same note an octave apart: learn these shapes and one note unlocks the rest.

tools.title: Tuner and metronome
tools.timingIntro: Bluetooth headphones and some phones add a delay. Tap the big button with each of the 8 clicks and the app will measure it.
tools.timingRetry: Not enough steady taps. Try again.

jam.legendHome: {{note}} = home. Land here to sound finished.
jam.legendChord: Notes of {{chord}}, the chord playing now. Land on these and you sound in tune with the band.
jam.legendScale: Other notes that fit. Use them to move between the yellow ones.
jam.legendBlue: Blue notes: gritty on purpose. Bend into them or slide past.
jam.legendAvoid: Avoid notes: a half step above a chord note. Pass through, don't stop on them.
jam.legendAvoidSimple: Grey = sounds tense over this chord. Pass through, don't stop on it.
jam.legendNext: Purple = the next chord is coming. Aim for these.
jam.headphones: Tip: headphones or a speaker you can turn up help you hear yourself over the band.

kindHints.triad: Three notes on three neighbouring strings. Small, fast, and they're everywhere: the key to playing chords anywhere.
kindHints.caged: The five open-chord shapes (C, A, G, E, D) moved up the neck. Ones marked "reference shape" are awkward to play; use them as a map.
kindHints.drop2: Four notes on four neighbouring strings. The classic sound for 7th chords.
kindHints.drop3: Bass note on string 6 or 5, skip a string, then three more. Full and warm.

chords.none: No shape fits this tuning here.
chords.greyHint: Grey dots: the same chord's notes elsewhere. Every group of them is another place to play it.
chords.trainerIntro: Keep your hand in one spot and play the whole progression there. The band plays, the neck shows the closest shape for each chord.
chords.namesOnlyHint: No dots now: play each chord inside the box from memory. Stuck? Switch back to Show shapes.
chords.builderIntro: Tap notes on the neck (one per string) and see what chord they make.
chords.noName: Not a chord I know. Try adding or moving a note.
chords.semitoneHint: Each step is one fret. +2 moves everything two frets up (higher).
chords.capoHint: Tip: put a capo on fret {{fret}} and play these shapes, and it sounds like your original chords.
